belief: My limitations disqualify me from God's purpose.
origins: We often equate purpose with achievement. When limitations constrain what we do, it seems that God’s purposes have passed us by.
teaches: “The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me.” “We know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.” “For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.” Purpose includes loving God and neighbor in each season. Jacob walked with a limp after wrestling with God and was blessed. Your limits are not obstacles to God.
self_statements: I am out of the picture.
errors: Believing purpose is either full or lost.
Predicting that I will never fulfill my calling.
Feeling limited and concluding I am disqualified.
questions: What do I think my purpose is?
Is purpose only doing, or also loving and trusting?
How have people with limitations served God?
What good works might God have prepared for me now?
What can I do within my limits?
Whom can I ask to help me see purpose?
truth: My limits do not cancel God’s purpose. He will fulfill His purpose for me, and I can love and serve within my condition.
hw_truths: The Lord will fulfill His purpose for me.
God works all things for good.
Good works are prepared for me.
log: Each week, note one act of love or service.
actions: Write love of God and neighbor as your purpose.
Serve in a way that fits.
prayer: Lord, fulfill Your purpose for me, even in limits. Show me how to love You and others each day. Amen.
